title: Reporting of Cash and Suspicious Transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit

paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to the reporting obligations of banks under the anti-money laundering framework. This circular specifies the threshold and filing deadline for Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) and the timeline and confidentiality requirements for Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to be furnished to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

The Principal Officer of the bank shall be responsible for furnishing Cash Transaction Reports and Suspicious Transaction Reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit in the electronic format prescribed by the FIU, and shall preserve the acknowledgement of every report so filed.

The threshold for Cash Transaction Reports shall be Rs 10 lakh: all cash transactions of Rs 10 lakh and above, or its equivalent in foreign currency, and all series of integrally connected cash transactions aggregating Rs 10 lakh or more within a calendar month, shall be reported.

The filing deadline for Cash Transaction Reports shall be the 15th day of the succeeding month: the Cash Transaction Report for each calendar month shall be furnished to the Financial Intelligence Unit on or before the 15th day of the month following the month of the transactions.

The timeline for filing a Suspicious Transaction Report shall be not later than 7 working days from the date on which the Principal Officer arrives at a conclusion that a transaction, whether cash or non-cash, or a series of transactions, is suspicious.

Tipping-off prohibition: the bank, its directors, officers and employees shall not disclose to the customer or any third party that a Suspicious Transaction Report or related information is being or has been furnished to the Financial Intelligence Unit. Operations in an account shall not be restricted solely because a Suspicious Transaction Report has been filed.

Attempted transactions: a Suspicious Transaction Report shall be filed even where a customer abandons or does not complete a transaction, irrespective of the amount involved. The Cash Transaction Report and Suspicious Transaction Report provisions of circular GZ-AML-2019-01 shall be effective from January 1, 2020.
